open_points.subject: public_op:canonical_values.fit_port_value
open_points.text: "size bound applying to the whole value" ... "checked in list order against the per-file size bound"
open_points.question: Which exact size ceiling must fit_port_value apply in each call, and how is that ceiling provided to the operation?
options: fit_port_value takes an explicit size ceiling argument from the caller
fit_port_value infers the ceiling from context (trial fixture vs stored value vs spool file)
open_points.default_guess: fit_port_value takes an explicit ceiling argument so callers choose the correct bound per rule context.

open_points.subject: public_op:store.read_value_bytes vs read_spooled_file spool-lifetime checks
open_points.text: Conventions: "surface checks it from runs.read_run before read_spooled_file; store trusts them." vs public_op title: "Return the bytes a StoredValue or SpooledFile names, refusing a released spool."
open_points.question: When a SpooledFile record exists but its run no longer holds spool, which module must enforce refusal, and what code should be returned from store.read_value_bytes/read_spooled_file?
options: surface enforces using runs.read_run; store does not enforce spool lifetime
store.read_value_bytes enforces spool lifetime and returns refused
both enforce (surface first, store as backstop)
open_points.default_guess: surface enforces and returns refused for read_spooled_file; store.read_value_bytes only resolves bytes and may return internal_error if missing.

open_points.subject: public_op:store.read_records relation semantics for mismatched existing references
open_points.text: "The record a relation names ... must exist, or the call is unknown_reference; from an existing record, an empty answer is a result"
open_points.question: For relation reads that take multiple existing references, if all referenced records exist but do not belong together (mismatched pair), should read_records return empty, unknown_reference, or internal_error?
open_points.default_guess: return empty result when references exist but have no matching relation.
